method: Direct inspection of all twelve iteration-78 pages, followed by direct inspection of final iteration-79 pages 8 and 9. The other ten rendered pages are byte-identical. Checked all figures, table, equations, captions, prose, page endings and references.

observations.pages_1_3: Question-led abstract and introduction; target, inputs, geometry and cascade legible. Geometry dimensions, ganging counts and schematic order agree with source.
observations.pages_4_6: All model/input equations and definitions legible. Flow transport precedes objective; solver evaluates current state at midpoint time. Loss terms and stage order retained.
observations.page_7: Gap equation, populations, graph-run lower bound, resampling and classifier split limits legible.
observations.page_8: Table values and denominators preserved. Figure 3 has HCAL-only log scaling, explicit layer-energy units and distinct 1–30/1–64 descriptions. Legend clear of data.
observations.page_9: Support panels have independent zero-based axes and correct units. All-event W1 population distinguished from nonempty means. Paragraph ends before page turn.
observations.page_10: Tolerance policy and earlier fixed-tolerance exceedance disclosed. Discussion fits as six complete paragraphs.
observations.pages_11_12: Conclusion, availability, declarations and all 18 references readable; no orphan heading or overlapping text.

scientific_scope: Document consistency and rendering review; not physics validation.
